title: Pad Thai
paragraphs: Pad Thai is a stir-fried rice noodle dish with tamarind, fish sauce, eggs, tofu, and often shrimp, garnished with peanuts and lime. It’s savory, tangy, and slightly sweet.
The dish rose to national fame in the mid-20th century and became a culinary ambassador for Thailand. Street vendors and restaurants tweak the balance of flavors to their style.
